name: contrib-cal-sync
description: Mirror a private GitLab contribution calendar into GitHub on macOS.

scripts.clean:build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.clean:test: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: npm run clean:test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-reporter=spec ".test-dist/test/**/*.test.js"
